name: Podcasts
short_desc: Service: your private podcast player. Follow shows, auto-download new episodes, resume anywhere.
description: Follow podcasts from the free Apple Podcasts directory, any RSS/Atom feed, or an OPML file. New episodes are checked in the background and downloaded to this app's storage under a size cap you choose. Play in the app with speed 0.8-3x and skip buttons; your place is saved on the Wizard so phone and desktop share it. Episodes come only from each show's public feed. Agents use it through MCP tools.
author: Humanity Labs
